releaseNotes: Smart Search is temporarily narrowed to PDF only so the large image library cannot interfere with indexing. PDF indexing now runs in two stages: Stage 1 reads searchable PDF text without OCR in batches of 10; Stage 2 OCRs only scanned/image PDFs one at a time to reduce memory pressure. Progress is persisted and shown as Indexed X of Y PDFs. The content index is rebuilt cleanly for this PDF-only phase, and images are intentionally not indexed while PDF indexing is validated. Existing Smart Search Index Settings, Resume/Rebuild controls, voice search and opening motion are preserved.
